title: Indian art through the ages
creator_credit: Documentary Films of India, M. Bhavnani and Mohan Wadhwani
brief_description: The camera explores exhibits at a display of fine arts in New Delhi, India to reveal the artistic achievements of past civilizations. Shows terracotta models which decorated the city of Mohenjodaro, 4500 years ago; includes specimens of Maurya, Kushan, Gupta and Chola art.
